title: bug: wolfHSM PKCS#1 pad integer underflow -> stack overflow
description: pkcs1_v15_pad_sign() in wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c checks key_size == 0 and key_size > HSM_RSA_MAX_BYTES but not key_size < 11. If key_size is in [1,10], the subtraction key_size - 11u underflows to a huge size_t, passing the length check. Then ps_len = key_size - in_len - 3u also underflows, and the subsequent memset(out+2, 0xFF, ps_len) writes far beyond the 512-byte padded[] stack buffer. Trigger: provision a key with key_size < 11 (misprovisioned or malicious), then call C_Sign.
